design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (rewards_points_earning_and_redemption), frozen_time 2026-09-24 11:20 EDT. Revision r2 (policy-task audit r1 rework).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 4]}. Assignment: gift card value (root) 5 factors, anniversary bonus 5, refund clawback 4. This first task claims rewards_ext_whole_balance_gift_card_value, rewards_ext_refund_clawback_points, rewards_ext_anniversary_bonus_amount and tools redeem_points_gift_card_91c84320, post_refund_clawback_4ceb9a03, credit_anniversary_bonus_4deaf7db; task 1 keeps the charity redemption, the courtesy credit and the quarterly milestone with their own tools.
Design thesis: surface goal "put my whole points balance on a Larkspur Home digital gift card" -> the gift card is not valued until the latest in-window merchant refund carries its clawback -> the clawback is fixed only after the most recent reached anniversary carries its bonus -> core numbers: bonus 9851, clawback 2520, gift card 9200 points worth 159.68 USD. Depth: two hops (chain). Breadth: 14 factors over the rewards ledger (12- and 3-month earning spend, clawback count, gift card count, boost count), the card ledger (refund, purchase dates, purchase count), the card tier, the wallet plan and wallet deposits.

[Problem-tree card] Root rewards_ext_whole_balance_gift_card_value (owner=user tool).
Edge 1: gift card -> rewards_ext_refund_clawback_points, value_input, gate gc_redeem_points, form state. Sentence (negated direction): "A whole-balance gift card redemption is not valued until the ledger carries a clawback entry for the latest merchant refund of an earning purchase posted within the clawback window." Four points: "not ... until"; waited-on side = a record-visible clawback entry; no code token; scope = the latest in-window refund, exactly what the clawback rule assesses (r2 narrowed it from "every merchant refund", audit D4). Only the clawback policy books clawback entries. Opening falsity: card_transactions 25df63f2-8a71-4526-a2e2-751226a1a5a1 (refund 1240.00, 2026-09-21, source 3f23f2f9-380b-42c7-bea8-e3c351c18c8e) has no clawback entry; the only clawback entry carries the 2026-02-14 purchase.
Edge 2: clawback -> rewards_ext_anniversary_bonus_amount, value_input, gate clawback_balance_cap, form state. Sentence (affirmative): "The points clawed back are fixed only after the ledger carries the anniversary bonus for the most recent enrolment anniversary the membership has reached while active." Scope narrowed in r2 to the most recent anniversary, matching the anniversary rule's own dedup (D4). Only the anniversary policy books anniversary entries. Opening falsity: enrolled 2022-09-19, active, latest anniversary entry 2025-09-19.
Order: anniversary, clawback, gift card; a chain, no parallel edge. Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skip the clawback -> gift card 11700 points / 216.13 instead of 9200 / 159.68; skip the anniversary -> clawback cut to 1924 instead of 2520, balance 0, gift card 0.00. The opening balance was lowered in r2 from 2724 to 1924 (the 2026-09-15 redemption is 800 points larger) so that the new rate-method clawback still exceeds it and edge 2 keeps its weight. The customer's own write is the root (base: "A redemption is the member's own decision to spend their points and is confirmed by the member in the app."). No tool validates any prerequisite.

[Base-invariant card] rewards_bonus: rewards_bonuses once-per-period gate superseded by the declared overwrite ("An anniversary bonus is credited only if the ledger carries no anniversary bonus entry dated on or after the most recent anniversary of the enrolled_date."); latest entry 2025-09-19 < 2026-09-19; membership active. rewards_clawback: clawback_window (time), anchor card_transactions.txn_date 2026-07-20, 90 calendar days (Obsidian), inclusive, day 1 = the day after; refund 2026-09-21 = day 63; 2026-10-18 would be day 90 (still claws back), 2026-10-19 day 91 (does not). negative_balance_allowed false -> cut. rewards_redemption: redeem_active -> active; points_pending_days 0 -> nothing pending, so a whole-balance redemption is available (r2 wording, audit D2); minimum 1000 <= 9200; increment 100.

[Business-object card] Clawback: latest refund 25df63f2-8a71-4526-a2e2-751226a1a5a1 -> purchase 3f23f2f9-380b-42c7-bea8-e3c351c18c8e (Bluewater Air, travel, 2480.00, earned 19840, no boost entry). Excluded: the 2026-03-02 refund (already carries a 1830-point clawback). Anniversary: year 2026. Gift card: the whole balance, brand Larkspur Home as stated.

[Factor card] Anniversary (9851; all-baseline 5000): bonus form (method: spend-based / blended / flat) blended 6101 (8750); tenure 4 years -> 1000 (8851); deposits + plan (multi-source, wallet) 50400.00 + Summit -> 1500 (8351); card (card) -> 1000 (8851); clean record one clawback -> 250 (9601). Near-miss: the 2025-09-24 Meridian Suites earning entry sits exactly twelve months back and is excluded (counted, the spend would be 54370.00 and the form 6218). The 2025-09-01 and 2025-08-01 deposits lie 12 months 23 days and 13 months 23 days back; they are outside the window but move no tier (the r1 dossier wrongly called the 2025-09-01 deposit exactly 12 months back — audit T0-R2).
Clawback (2520; all-baseline 9920): age method (method, card; r2 replaces the r1 multiplier, audit D1/T0-R1): refund age 63 > 60 -> rate method, refunded amount x base rate 3.0 = 3720 in place of the proportional share 9920; 31-60 days would take the lower of the two; up to 30 days the proportional share (8720); loyalty (multi-source) 750 (3270); category travel 300 (2820); card activity 10 purchases 150 (2670). Near-miss: the 2026-06-24 purchase sits exactly three months back and is not counted; the older refund is not the latest.
Gift card (159.68; all-baseline 138.0): engaged spender (multi-source) 12410.00 + 4 years -> 0.05 (155.08); card tier 0.10 (150.48); redeemer 3 -> 0.02 (157.84); boost 2 -> 0.02 (157.84); plan valuation (method, wallet, multi-source; r2 replaces the r1 multiplier): Summit + 4200.00 -> banded valuation (first 5000 points at the rate, the rest at the rate + 0.10 cents); a paid plan with 500+ of deposits would take the block valuation (+250 cents per full 5000 points); otherwise flat (155.48). Near-miss: the 2026-06-08 charity redemption is not a gift card; the two boost activations are not boost entries; the 2026-06-24 earning entry is exactly three months back.
Vocabulary (audit D6/T0-O1): every rule now states "Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.", so the spend measures read earning rows only.

[Seed] Renata Ostrowski; wallet Summit (14 payroll deposits of 4200.00, 13 cash-outs); one Visa Infinite Metal card; 25 purchases 2025-09-24..2026-09-18 with earning entries; two refunds; one old clawback; two boosts; anniversary bonuses 2023-2025; three gift card and one charity redemption, each fulfilled the same day (no courtesy owed). Opening balance 1924. Tier review 2026-10-01 lies after frozen_time; no automatic clause fires.

[Persona] Volunteers the whole-balance Larkspur Home request and a vague memory of "a little under two thousand points" (true: 1924); identity on request; one passive go-ahead when the agent says something must be dealt with first (r2 removed "or that points need to be added or taken back", audit T0-O2); runs the redemption herself; closes when told it went through.

[Standard solution] locate by phone -> verify (phone, email, dob) -> read membership, ledger, cards, card activity, wallet, wallet activity -> credit anniversary 2026 = 9851 (balance 11775) -> clawback on 3f23f2f9-380b-42c7-bea8-e3c351c18c8e, 1240.00, 2520 (balance 9255) -> hand over the gift card: 9200 points, Larkspur Home, 159.68 USD.

[Verification run] The scratchpad builder replayed the gold with the real tools and evaluated each computation on its handling-time world with check_compute's evaluator; expected, baseline_result and factor_sensitivity are those printed values; gate outputs are in the difficulty worklog.

[Draft recalculation from visible context] The ledger shows the missing 2026 anniversary entry and the unclawed 2026-09-21 refund; the sentences fix the order; the rules and records alone reproduce 9851 / 2520 / 9200 / 159.68.
user_scenario:
You are Renata Ostrowski, a forty-year-old freight planner in Oakland who has just moved into a new apartment and is buying furniture for it. You open the chat because you want to turn all of your Pocketwire Rewards points into a Larkspur Home digital gift card today: the whole balance, not part of it. You glanced at the app this morning and think it showed a little under two thousand points, but you are not sure, and you want the agent to use whatever the real, correct number is. You have no idea how points are valued and you have no dollar figure in mind for the card; you just want the most your points are worth.
You write in short, friendly messages. When the agent asks who you are, you give your mobile number, 5552641187. If the agent needs more to confirm it is you, you add your email, renata.ostrowski@pw4mail.example, and your date of birth, 1986-03-14. You would rather not share your Social Security digits; only if the agent says those three details are still not enough do you give the last four, 4471, and your home ZIP, 94610.
You do not know anything about your account beyond what you just said. If the agent tells you that something on your points account has to be dealt with before the gift card, you say that is fine and that they should go ahead and do whatever the rules require; you do not need to approve each step separately, and you do not ask how it works. If the agent tells you a number and asks whether it sounds right, you say you have no way to check it and that you trust the record.
You want to confirm the redemption yourself. When the agent hands the gift card redemption over to you to confirm, you confirm it with the points and the value the agent gives you and the brand written exactly as Larkspur Home, and if the agent asks, you read back the redemption reference you are shown. If the agent asks where the card should be delivered, the email on your account is fine. Once the agent tells you the gift card redemption has gone through, you thank them and say goodbye.
